plan: A marksman who slows with every attack and can stun from very far with her ice arrow.
aSurveiller: Her R (Enchanted Crystal Arrow). It crosses the map and stuns longer if it comes from far away: be careful when you are alone.
contrer: Engage her in melee range: she has no escape.
Don't walk in a straight line in narrow corridors: her arrow (R) flies straight.
Don't chase her too far: each of her attacks slows you.
forces: Her R starts fights from very far.
Gives vision anywhere with her hawk (E).
faiblesses: Vulnerable if an assassin reaches her.

sorts.Q: Increases her attack speed and fires several arrows at once.
sorts.E: Sends her hawk to reveal an area.
sorts.R: Arrow that crosses the map and stuns.

momentFort: Useful from the start, and dangerous in the mid game with her attack speed items.
